Cover each scene. The script is what happens; you decide the camera setups in this director's style, and place every spoken line in the shot it is spoken in. Copy sceneNumber from the "## Scene N" headings.

<DIRECTOR_STYLE>
Mood: Authentic and immediate
Camera: Handheld camera with observational framing
References: vertiginous big-wall climbing documentary; unflinching observational documentary portraiture; tense vérité whistleblower documentary
</DIRECTOR_STYLE>

<CHARACTERS>
- MAYA
- DEV
</CHARACTERS>

<SCENES>
## Scene 1 — CORNER DINER
INT. CORNER DINER - NIGHT
shots: up to 20

INT. CORNER DINER - NIGHT

MAYA, 30s, a waitress in a grey t-shirt and red apron, wipes down the chrome counter. DEV, 40s, a long-haul driver in a canvas jacket, sits on the last stool.

MAYA
You're late. The kitchen closed an hour ago.

DEV
Then I'll take coffee and an argument.

MAYA
Coffee's free. The argument costs extra.

---

## Scene 2 — DINER CAR PARK
EXT. DINER CAR PARK - NIGHT
shots: up to 13

EXT. DINER CAR PARK - NIGHT

Rain on gravel. DEV stands beside his truck. MAYA steps out and flips the sign to closed.

MAYA
Take the pie. It won't keep.

DEV
You're a hard woman to say no to.
</SCENES>
